tools.name: search_gyms
tools.description: Find gyms and studios (CrossFit, HYROX, fitness, yoga, pilates, boxing, martial arts, dance, climbing) in France and Europe, near a point or by name, city or postcode. Activity words in the query filter ('CrossFit Nice', 'yoga Lyon'); the rest is the place or the gym name. Gymmy gyms (onGymmy: true)

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: Details of a gym: for a Gymmy gym its description, address, opening hours, sites, how to book, page and join links; for a gym not on Gymmy its address, opening hours, own booking link and sourced prices (with source and date, not verified by Gymmy), and its listing page.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming classes of a Gymmy gym (next 14 days): time, duration, spots left, and a booking link with the class already picked.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Memberships, class packs and trial offers of a Gymmy gym with prices in EUR and a direct sign-up link per offer.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Gives the link to book a trial class at a Gymmy gym, with the trial offer and optionally the class already picked. The person opens it and confirms with their name and email; nothing is booked or charged by this tool.

tools.name: search_classes
tools.description: Classes open to visitors right now at Gymmy gyms that accept drop-ins from anywhere (trial, single class or class pack), near a place or point, optionally one day or one kind of class ('hyrox', 'yoga'). Each result has the gym, class_id, date, spots left, the cheapest price and the offers that book

tools.name: book_dropin
tools.description: Buys a trial, a single class or a class pack at a Gymmy gym and books the class in one go, for the signed-in person (any Gymmy account, no membership needed). First call without confirm: returns the summary (price, class) to confirm with the person. Then call with confirm: true, first_name and last_

tools.name: join_gym
tools.description: Signs the signed-in person up to a Gymmy gym's membership or class pack (from get_prices), paid on the gym's own Stripe Checkout page. First call without confirm returns the summary to confirm; then confirm: true with first_name and last_name returns the payment link. Follow up with checkout_status.

tools.name: checkout_status
tools.description: Status of a purchase started with book_dropin or join_gym (ref): pending (checkout open), processing (bank debit), paid, free or failed, and whether the gym now shows in the person's Gymmy account. The widget calls it by itself after the Stripe page opens; call it when the person says they paid or a

tools.name: my_gyms
tools.description: Gyms the signed-in Gymmy member belongs to.

tools.name: my_bookings
tools.description: The signed-in member's upcoming booked and waitlisted classes (next 2 weeks), across all their Gymmy gyms (or one with gym).

tools.name: my_schedule
tools.description: Classes for a week at the signed-in member's gyms (all of them, or one with gym), with the class ids book_class needs, spots left and whether they are booked.

tools.name: book_class
tools.description: Books a class at one of the signed-in member's gyms with their own membership (or puts them on the waitlist when full, if the gym allows). Uses the gym's booking rules. No payment is taken here.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels the signed-in member's booking (or waitlist spot) for a class. The gym's cancellation deadline applies; a late cancel may count as used.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_gyms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
